pipelines.name: PR Lifecycle

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Reconcile PR draft state with check outcome
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# workflow_run payloads omit PR refs for fork PRs, and the
# commits/{sha}/pulls endpoint returns an empty list for fork PRs
# under the app token (observed live in run 35081347892), so match
# the head SHA against the open PR list instead.
pr_json=$(gh api "repos/argoproj/argo-helm/pulls?state=open&per_page=100" --paginate             --jq '[.[] | select(.head.sha == env.HEAD_SHA)] | first')
if [ -z "${pr_json}" ] || [ "${pr_json}" = "null" ]; then
  echo "No open PR with current head ${HEAD_SHA}; stale run or PR closed. Nothing to do."; exit 0
fi
pr=$(echo "${pr_json}" | jq -r .number)
author=$(echo "${pr_json}" | jq -r .user.login)
is_draft=$(echo "${pr_json}" | jq -r .draft)
node_id=$(echo "${pr_json}" | jq -r .node_id)
has_label=$(echo "${pr_json}" | jq -r --arg l "${MARKER_LABEL}" '[.labels[].name] | contains([$l])')

case "${author}" in
  *"[bot]") echo "Bot-authored PR #${pr}; skipping."; exit 0 ;;
esac

if [ "${CONCLUSION}" = "failure" ]; then
  if [ "${is_draft}" = "true" ]; then
    echo "PR #${pr} already draft; nothing to do."; exit 0
  fi
  # Draft at most once per head SHA: a hidden marker comment records it.
  if gh api "repos/argoproj/argo-helm/issues/${pr}/comments" --paginate \
       --jq '.[].body' | grep -q "pr-lifecycle:drafted:${HEAD_SHA}"; then
    echo "Already drafted once for ${HEAD_SHA}; respecting the author's ready state."; exit 0
  fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2016 # $id is a GraphQL variable substituted server-side by gh, not a shell expansion
gh api graphql -f query='mutation($id: ID!) { convertPullRequestToDraft(input: {pullRequestId: $id}) { pullRequest { isDraft } } }' -f id="${node_id}"
  gh api "repos/argoproj/argo-helm/issues/${pr}/labels" -f "labels[]=${MARKER_LABEL}"
  gh api "repos/argoproj/argo-helm/issues/${pr}/comments" -f body="$(printf '<!-- pr-lifecycle:drafted:%s -->\nRequired checks failed, so this PR was converted to a draft to keep the review queue green. Push a fix (the PR returns to ready automatically when checks pass) or mark it ready yourself to discuss as is. Details: the failing run is linked in the checks tab.' "${HEAD_SHA}")"
  echo "Drafted PR #${pr}."
elif [ "${CONCLUSION}" = "success" ]; then
  if [ "${has_label}" != "true" ]; then
    echo "PR #${pr} was not auto-drafted; leaving state alone."; exit 0
  fi
  # shellcheck disable=SC2016 # $id is a GraphQL variable substituted server-side by gh, not a shell expansion
gh api graphql -f query='mutation($id: ID!) { markPullRequestReadyForReview(input: {pullRequestId: $id}) { pullRequest { isDraft } } }' -f id="${node_id}"
  gh api -X DELETE "repos/argoproj/argo-helm/issues/${pr}/labels/${MARKER_LABEL}"
  echo "PR #${pr} back to ready."
else
  echo "Conclusion ${CONCLUSION}; nothing to do."
fi

pipelines.name: Chart Publish

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Fold change fragments
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
echo "sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
./scripts/fold-changes.sh | tee "${RUNNER_TEMP}/folded.txt"
if [[ -s "${RUNNER_TEMP}/folded.txt" ]]; then
  echo "folded=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "folded=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Push version bumps
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
user_id=$(gh api "/users/${APP_SLUG}[bot]" --jq .id)
git config user.name "${APP_SLUG}[bot]"
git config user.email "${user_id}+${APP_SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git add -A charts
git commit -s -m "chore(release): fold change fragments" -m "$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/folded.txt")"
remote="https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
# A merge can land after checkout. If the rebase conflicts, that merge's own run folds again.
for _ in 1 2 3; do
  git push "${remote}" HEAD:main && exit 0
  git pull --rebase "${remote}" main
done
exit 1

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
List changed charts
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch --tags >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
if ! latest_tag=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD~ 2>/dev/null); then
  latest_tag=$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 --first-parent HEAD)
fi
echo "Discovering changed charts since '${latest_tag}'..."

changed_charts=()
while IFS= read -r chart; do
  [[ -n "${chart}" && -d "${chart}" ]] || continue
  if [[ -f "${chart}/Chart.yaml" ]]; then
    changed_charts+=("${chart}")
  else
    echo "WARNING: ${chart}/Chart.yaml is missing, assuming that '${chart}' is not a Helm chart. Skipping." >&2
  fi
done < <(git diff --find-renames --name-only "${latest_tag}" -- charts | cut -d '/' -f 1-2 | uniq)

if [[ ${#changed_charts[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "Nothing to do. No chart changes detected."
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "Changed charts: ${changed_charts[*]}"
  echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "charts=${changed_charts[*]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Add dependency chart repos
steps.run: helm repo add dandydeveloper https://dandydeveloper.github.io/charts/

steps.name: Build chart dependencies
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
read -ra charts <<< "${CHARTS}"
for chart in "${charts[@]}"; do
  helm dependency build "${chart}"
done

steps.name: Verify subchart digests
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
read -ra charts <<< "${CHARTS}"
./scripts/verify-chart-dependencies.sh "${charts[@]}"

steps.name: Package and sign charts
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
signing_key=$(yq '.key' ./.github/configs/cr.yaml)
if [[ -z "${signing_key}" || "${signing_key}" == "null" ]]; then
  echo "::error::No signing key name set in .github/configs/cr.yaml"
  exit 1
fi

key_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/signing"
trap 'rm -rf "${key_dir}"' EXIT
mkdir -m 700 "${key_dir}"
printf '%s\n' "${PGP_PRIVATE_KEY}" | gpg --dearmor > "${key_dir}/secring.gpg"
# Only pass a passphrase file when the secret holds one: helm rejects
# an empty passphrase file.
sign_args=(--sign --key "${signing_key}" --keyring "${key_dir}/secring.gpg")
if [[ -n "${PGP_PASSPHRASE}" ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "${PGP_PASSPHRASE}" > "${key_dir}/passphrase.txt"
  sign_args+=(--passphrase-file "${key_dir}/passphrase.txt")
fi

rm -rf .cr-release-packages
mkdir -p .cr-release-packages
read -ra charts <<< "${CHARTS}"
for chart in "${charts[@]}"; do
  echo "Packaging chart '${chart}'..."
  helm package "${chart}" \
    --destination .cr-release-packages \
    "${sign_args[@]}"
done

steps.name: Remove signing material
steps.run: rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/signing"

steps.name: Harden the runner (Audit all outbound calls)
Configure Git
steps.run:
git config user.name "$GITHUB_ACTOR"
git config user.email "$GITHUB_ACTOR@users.noreply.github.com"

steps.name: Fetch current Chart Index
steps.run: git checkout origin/gh-pages index.yaml

steps.name: Run chart-releaser
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
owner="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY%%/*}"
repo="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY#*/}"

echo 'Releasing charts...'
cr upload -o "${owner}" -r "${repo}" -c "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" --config ./.github/configs/cr.yaml

echo 'Updating charts repo index...'
cr index -o "${owner}" -r "${repo}" --push --config ./.github/configs/cr.yaml

steps.name: Push chart to GHCR
steps.run:
shopt -s nullglob
for pkg in .cr-release-packages/*.tgz; do
  if [ -z "${pkg:-}" ]; then
    break
  fi
  helm push "${pkg}" "oci://ghcr.io/${REPOSITORY}"
done
